summary: Tested the simplified payment logic (constant deposit, per-month paid/not_paid). Backend: 5/6 pytest tests pass against the live preview URL. Frontend: all target pages render correctly (Tenants columns, Payments grouped view + toggle + summary cards, Tenant Detail without legacy totals). Found 2 real issues: (1) GET /api/tenants leaks legacy fields `total_paid` and `remaining_balance` for pre-existing DB records — violates spec. (2) Dashboard UI shows 0 for Reddito Mensile / Totale Incassato / Saldo In Sospeso because frontend still reads old keys (monthly_income/total_collected/total_outstanding) while backend now returns `month_collected` + removed outstanding.

critical.issue: Pre-existing tenant documents in MongoDB still carry legacy fields `total_paid` and `remaining_balance` (and nested `current_property`) which are returned as-is. Spec requires NO remaining_balance and NO total_due/total_paid in tenant responses. Root cause: _enrich_tenant only adds new fields and does not strip obsolete ones from the stored dict; no data migration was run.

minor.issue: Newly created tenants do not contain legacy fields, so only tenants created before the refactor leak them. Suggest either a migration to $unset total_paid/remaining_balance or whitelist the response in _enrich_tenant.

integration_issues.issue: Reddito Mensile, Totale Incassato and Saldo In Sospeso all render as €0 although the backend /api/dashboard/stats returns `month_collected` (>0 when there are payments) and no longer returns `total_outstanding`. Frontend is likely reading old keys (monthly_income / total_collected / total_outstanding). Depositi Totali (total_deposits) renders correctly (€9,900).

issues: 'Saldo In Sospeso' label should be removed entirely per spec (no deposit-based outstanding).

action_items: Strip or migrate legacy fields total_paid and remaining_balance from tenant responses (either unset in DB or return only whitelisted fields from _enrich_tenant).
Update Dashboard.js to read the new keys: month_collected (instead of monthly_income/total_collected) and remove the Saldo In Sospeso card (total_outstanding no longer exists).
critical_code_review_comments: routes/tenants.py _enrich_tenant mutates and returns the raw MongoDB doc (minus _id). Consider building a fresh response dict with only the simplified keys to guarantee no legacy field leaks regardless of historical DB state.
routes/payments.py POST /payments correctly no longer touches tenant.total_paid — verified. Good.
routes/dashboard.py cleanly removes total_outstanding; however frontend still references the removed keys.
routes/rooms.py occupancy-overview and routes/payments.py payments/overview duplicate ~40 lines of month-aggregation logic — extract a shared helper to DRY.
_current_month_range is only in tenants.py; duplicated inline in dashboard.py, payments.py, rooms.py. Move to a shared utils module.
updated_files: /app/backend/tests/test_simplified_payments.py (new pytest suite for simplified payment logic)

success_rate.backend: 83% (5/6 simplified-logic tests pass; failing test is on legacy field leak in GET /api/tenants)
success_rate.frontend: 85% (all requested UI structure correct; Dashboard numeric cards mis-wired to removed keys)

seed_data_creation: Module-scoped fixture creates a TEST_ landlord -> property -> room -> tenant, assigns the tenant, registers a €500 current-month payment, then tears everything down. The one failing test does not depend on the fixture (it lists existing tenants to expose legacy leaks).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL=https://property-ops-16.preview.emergentagent.com python -m pytest backend/tests/test_simplified_payments.py -v. Seeder requires landlord payload with whatsapp+id_number+bank_details and property payload with number_of_rooms+capacity+rental_amount+deposit_amount. After main agent fix, re-verify: GET /api/tenants has NO total_paid/remaining_balance for ANY tenant (including Mario Rossi seed), and Dashboard shows non-zero Reddito Mensile when current-month payments exist. Payments Overview grouping verified working. Occupancy-overview uses current month verified working. POST /payments verified NOT updating tenant.total_paid.
rca_of_the_issue: Legacy tenant docs predate the schema simplification. _enrich_tenant returns the mongo doc as-is (minus _id) which still contains total_paid and remaining_balance for those old rows. Fix options: (a) one-time migration: db.tenants.update_many({}, {$unset: {total_paid:'', remaining_balance:'', current_property:''}}) or (b) construct response dict from a fixed whitelist. Frontend Dashboard mismatch is a simple key rename to match new backend contract.
